definitions.gloss: to leave as is; to keep unchanged; to hold at the current level
definitions.explanation: To maintain something at its current state or level without changing it. Commonly used for prices, interest rates, taxes, and other quantitative measures that could be raised or lowered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{置|お}く。
⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{置|お}くこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: It was decided to keep tuition fees unchanged this fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}{金利|きんり}→政策金利：26656_seisakukinri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{現行|げんこう}→現行：13503_genkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水準|すいじゅん}→水準：03357_suijun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{据|す}え{置|お}くこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全会|ぜんかい}{一致|いっち}→全会一致：09760_zenkaiicchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The Bank of Japan unanimously decided to keep the policy interest rate at its current level.

notes:
Godan verb (⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ row): {据|す}え{置|お}く・{据|す}え{置|お}きます
て-form: {据|す}え{置|お}いて
た-form: {据|す}え{置|お}いた

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{置|お}く (to hold interest rates steady)
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{置|お}く (to keep prices unchanged)
- ⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{据|す}え{置|お}く (to maintain the tax rate)
- ⟦{据|す}え{置|お}き→据え置き：18902_sueoki⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (grace period; deferment period)

FORMS:
- ⟦{据|す}え{置|お}き→据え置き：18902_sueoki⟧ (noun form) — often used in compound phrases like ⟦{据|す}え{置|お}き→据え置き：18902_sueoki⟧{型|がた} (stationary type) or ⟦{据|す}え{置|お}き→据え置き：18902_sueoki⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (deferment period).

USAGE:
Primarily used in financial, economic, and policy contexts. Very common in news reporting about central bank decisions and pricing.
